newsitem.title: UK: Legal & General launches direct pension.
newsitem.headline: Legal & General launches direct pension.

text.p: Legal & General Group Plc on Monday announced the launch of a 'direct' pension product to be sold over the telephone.
The new pension will compete with similar direct products offered by companies such as Richard Branson's Virgin, Eagle Star, Scottish Widows and Marks & Spencer.
Customers will receive general information about the product on offer but not client specific advice.
Calls will be dealt with by the company's existing call centre in Cardiff.
"As a major player in the pensions market, we believe in offering our customers a choice in how they buy their Legal & General pension," said Tony Filbin, head of Pensions at the company.
The company estimate that around three percent of the public prefer to buy pensions direct from insurers.
